description: US-3: single-focal-point moves from level 2 (fail) to level 0 (pass), so its change is better. faint-body-text stays fail but its defect probability rises from 0.75 to 0.95, so it is worse by value. The four criteria give one change of each kind, the summary counts them, and skipped is empty because both runs skip the same criterion (FR-35, FR-36, FR-37, FR-39, section 8.2).
